name: @loadout/plugin-tdp-control
description: TDP (Thermal Design Power) control for Linux handhelds — adjust wattage via ryzenadj or sysfs

plugin.name: TDP Control
plugin.description: Adjust CPU/APU TDP wattage with presets and a slider

bundled_bins.name: ryzenadj
bundled_bins.rationale: AMD-only SMU write tool; required on stock SteamOS where ryzenadj isn't packaged (/usr is read-only). ~104 KB, dynamic-links libpci/libudev/libcap which are present on every supported distro.

plugin.subtitle: CPU/GPU power limits

agent.summary: Read and set the APU's sustained power limit (TDP) in watts, plus the related CPU/GPU knobs: governor, energy-performance preference, GPU clock range and mode, SMT and CPU boost. Supports named presets and per-game profiles that apply automatically on launch.

getTdpInfo.description: Current TDP in watts plus the min/max the device supports. Read this before setting a limit — the safe range is device-specific.

setTdp.description: Set the sustained power limit in watts. Takes effect immediately and affects performance, battery life and heat on the device the user is holding.
setTdp.notes: Clamped to the device's supported range, which getTdpInfo reports. Not persisted across reboot on its own — applyProfile is the durable path.

getProfiles.description: The saved named presets, keyed by name.

applyProfile.description: Apply a saved preset by name. Names come from getProfiles.

getAcPowerStatus.description: Whether the device is on AC or battery.

setGpuMode.description: GPU clock policy. `manual` is what makes setGpuFreqRange take effect.

setGpuFreqRange.notes: Requires setGpuMode("manual") first, or the range is ignored.

setSmt.notes: Offlines CPU threads. A running game will stutter or crash. Don't touch this while the user is playing.

setGameProfile.description: Save a per-game TDP applied automatically when that game launches.

setCustomDevice.notes: Overrides autodetected device limits. Wrong values can push the APU outside its safe range.
